title: 'Biologics' as soft-tissue drones in conscious craft

tellings.quote: So the biologics could be something like soft tissue drones.

plain: The living beings said to be found with crashed craft, often called 'biologics', may not be pilots at all but something like soft-tissue drones serving a conscious craft. Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he lifted a UFO with his helicopter, puts it forward on Michels's show in 2025, passing on what he was told by a man he names only as Dave. If true, the bodies would be tools of the craft rather than its crew.
